items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Oh, there was Paul Webster, there was Shag Collins, Lamar Wright, Jr. ... But when I came in the band, it was Shad Collins, Paul Webster, Lamar Wright, Jr., and I think -- Eddie Mullens.

ctx.x: Can you name some of the guys who was in that big band?
Oh, there was Paul Webster, there was Shag Collins, Lamar Wright, Jr.
